question: Should OpenClaw retire `coalesceSameSenderDms` now and make `imsg` 0.11.1 a hard iMessage startup floor, accepting doctor and binary-upgrade actions for existing users?
rationale: This turns previously accepted persisted config and older binaries into fail-closed upgrade states; tests can prove mechanics but cannot choose the compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Accept the hard floor and config retirement after exact-head macOS proof covers doctor migration, old-version recovery messaging, and split-send delivery.

options.title: Defer retirement
options.body: Keep the current option and client-side fallback until maintainers are ready to require the binary and config upgrade together.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the hard floor and config retirement after exact-head macOS proof covers doctor migration, old-version recovery messaging, and split-send delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the supported `imsg` release floor and operator upgrade policy for that dependency.
